pairs.evidence: app/(studio)/ledger/_ledger/read.ts:214 readStrip runs one kernel count per day of the strip (up to 84 per render), and readFacets one per held project, where a single grouped aggregate query would give the same answer; the query count grows with the number of days or projects shown.

techniques.evidence: app/(studio)/ledger/_ledger/read.ts:214 The loop exists only to get a count per day: the technique's 'aggregate summaries' case, which calls for one grouped query. read.ts:171 does the same per project.
app/(studio)/ledger/_ledger/read.ts:5 The screen has no SQL. A search of the ledger directory found no prepare/SELECT. Every read goes through named kernel operations (queryEvents/countEvents).
app/(studio)/ledger/_ledger/read.ts:158 Facets/Page/Strip are read-only projections shaped for the screen, and each count names its predicate (each facet with its own filter left out).

pairs.evidence: lib/foundry/catalogue.ts:123 A lib/ adapter holds the kernel Store and runs its own 'one tiny' SQL probe against the styles table instead of calling a named kernel operation, so the query language leaks outside the kernel's module tree.

techniques.evidence: lib/foundry/catalogue.ts:123 The exact leak the technique names: an inline count/exists query outside the data layer.

lib/foundry/store.ts:112 scanRuns drops a run with a damaged verdicts.json from both items and the warnings channel (listManifests ignores a null summary). Only a console line records it, so the feed sees the run as gone. readJson also casts with no shape check (runStore.ts:64). Single-record reads do keep unreadable and absent apart (store.ts:88).
lib/foundry/store.ts:310 Evidence rows and run grades are written in one store transaction before any file is touched. A failure leaves the banner 'nothing was deleted' true.
lib/foundry/store.ts:357 Order is store, then indices (store.ts:326), then unlinks, then run.json marked committed last. Readers gate on run.status, so a crash leaves the run retryable.
